execution.model: Synthetic stand-in returning fixed velocities; real official CPU scheduler

checks: Source mismatch rejects worker before model loading
Mixed observation/action/target cache is rejected before any get_tensor call
Exactly one positive and one negative call, same latent/token times, inference mode, 720 tokens and fixed clean first observation
Guidance equals negative+5*(positive-negative); one original CPU UniPC step matches its first-order delta-sigma formula within 2e-6 absolute/relative, and clean prefix is restored exactly
Saved inputs preserve exact future noise and 144 zero-time observed tokens; timing includes exactly one stage per forward and one solver step
Metrics explicitly deny full-video and quality claims and record 900-second/18-GiB/2-GiB guards
Second-forward failure or KeyboardInterrupt retains input artifacts, omits completed outputs/pair timing and records failed/interrupted status
fixed_issue: Observation reader previously used load_file before checking keys, which could materialize rejected action/target values. It now uses safe_open, validates exact key set first, and reads observation only.

read_review.guarding: Parent handoff_and_guard covers stdin, child cleanup, wall time, process RSS and available RAM; worker adds Metal cap, periodic device sampling and stage checks. Forced-stop terminal/watchdog evidence must be read with metrics.
read_review.inputs: Native codec source/file/tensor/original-image hashes and genuine cached UMT5 prompt identities checked before launch and again in worker. No decoder, renderer, pose/action inputs, target loader or full sampling loop.
read_review.precision_and_timing: Reviewed selective-BF16 core with FP32 modulation/head/velocity/CFG/CPU solver. Forward timings synchronize MPS before/after. One-pair extrapolation is explicitly incomplete and cannot itself pass a generation budget gate.
read_review.provenance: Parent snapshots current core and reused helper sources, hashes CPU reports, and worker rechecks source identities. Core loader verifies all original shard/index/config hashes and converted tensor values.
read_review.readiness: No remaining concrete profiler blocker found after the selective-reader fix. Actual 5B runtime and a full clip remain unmeasured.

limits: The worker tests use synthetic contexts and a stand-in denoiser, not genuine 5B inference or image-quality evaluation. Actual codec and text integrity are enforced by source-reviewed loaders and separately passing implementation checks.
